content: Yerusalaame Bolla Senakireeme Mande
Kawo Hizqiyaasi kawotida tammanne oydanththo layththan, Asoore kawo Senakireemey gimbettida Yuhuda katamata ubbaa oli oykkides.

Asoore kawoy Laakishe geetettiza katamappe ola gadawa cora olanchchatara kawo Hizqiyaasakko Yerusalaame yeddides. Ola gadawazi May7o meeccizaadeza gadekko efiza ogeppe qommo baggara diza eele haaththaako iza zara lanqen eqqides.
Kawo keeth ayssiza Kilqiyaasa naa Elyaaqeemey, xaafezi Sheebinaynne taarike xaafezi Aasaafe naa Yo7aahii izakko kare kezida.
Ola gadawazi isttas, «Hizqiyaasasi, ‹Wolqqama Asoore kawo, neni hayssa mala ne ammanettiday aazanee?
Neni ola erateththinne mino olanchchati taas deettes gaasa; gido attiin neni go7ay baynda qaala xalla haasayaasa; histtiin ne oonan ammanettada ta bolla makkallay?
Hekko neni asi iza oykki darttiin meqqidi madunththiza maqqa misatiza Gibxen ammanettadasa; Gibxe kawo Paarooneykka izan ammanettiza ubbaas hessa mala.›

«Neni taas, ‹Nuni GODAAN, nu Xoossan ammanettoos› giikko, izas goynniza dhoqqasohotanne yarshosohota Hizqiyaasi laallidi Yuhuda asaanne Yerusalaame asaa, ‹Intte goynnanaas bessizay hayssa mala issi yarshoson xalla gidanaas bessees› gibeennee?
«Ane ha7i haa yaada ta godaa Asoore kawora giigana mala haasaya; nees toga dandayza asati diikko 2,000 parata tani nees immana.
Neni Gibxe para-gaaretaninne toganchchatan ammanettizaa gidikko ta godaa olanchchatappe issi laafa butteza ne wostta zaaranee?
Qasse hayssa biitta dhayssanaas GODAA azazoy baynda ta yidaa nees misatizee? GODAY ba hu7era hayssa deraa tani ola dhayssana mala taas yootides» gides.
Elyaaqeemey, Sheebinaynne Yo7aahi ola gadawaza, «Nu eriza Aaraame qaalara nuus ne aylletas yoota; gimbeza bolla diza derezi eriza, Ibraaweta qaalan nuus yootoppa» gida.

Gido attiin ola gadawazi zaaridi, «Ta goday tana kiitti yeddiday hayta ha yo7ota ne godaassinne nees xalla yootanaassee? Intte mala bantta shiya maanaassinne bantta sheesh uyanaas gimbe bolla uttida asaassara yootana mala gidennee?» gides.
Hessafe guye ola gadawazi Ibraaweta qaalara ba qaala dhoqqu histtidi, «Wogga wolqqama Asoore kawo qaala siyite!
Kawozi, ‹Hizqiyaasi inttena cimmofo; izi inttena ashshana dandayenna.
GODAY tuma nuna ashshana; ha katamayakka Asoore kawos imettuku› giidi intte GODAAN ammanettana mala ooththofo» gides.
«Hizqiyaasi gizayssa siyopite. Asoore kawoy inttena, ‹Tanara sigettite; haa taakko kezite. Hessafe guye intte ubbayka intte woyneppenne intte balaseppe maandeta; intte bookkida ollafe haath uyandeta.
Hessa intte hananay tani yaada inttena intte biitta misatiza dere denththa efana gakkanaassa. He biittay kaththinne woyne ushshi, kaththa biittanne woyne atakiltey kumida biitta› gees.
«Hizqiyaasi, ‹GODAY nuna ashshana› giidi inttena cimmofo. Hanno gakkanaas kawoteththata xoossatappe ba deraa Asoore kawo kusheppe ashshida xoossi dizee?
Hamaate xoossatinne Arfaade xoossati awan dizoo? Sefarwayme xoossati awan dizoo? Hayti Samaariya ta kusheppe ashshidoo?
Hayta ha dereta xoossata ubbaafe ba deraa ta kusheppe ashshana dandayday awayssee? Histtiin GODAY Yerusalaame ta kusheppe wostti ashshana dandayzee?» gides.
Gido attiin kawozi isttas, «Izas aykkoka zaaropite» gi azazida gishshas asay issi qaalakka qaattontta co7u gides.

Hessafe guye kawo keeth ayssiza Kilqiyaasa naa Elyaaqeemey, xaafe Sheebinaynne taarike xaafezi Aasaafe naa Yo7aahi bantta may7o daakkidi Hizqiyaasakko bida; histtidi Asooreta ola gadaway gidayssa ubbaa izas yootida.
